title.big: Spread-mooring SF check, answered in chat
title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: I've got an FPSO on a spread mooring and want a quick intact safety-factor screen on the lines. Can you run it?

Happy to screen it — a few things so I set it up right:
  • Vessel — length, beam, draft, displacement?
  • Water depth, and the mooring layout (how many lines, anchor and fairlead radius)?
  • Line make-up — material, line length, and pretension?
  • The metocean to screen against — wave height/period, current, wind?
This runs the intact quasi-static screen for steel chain or wire. Synthetic rope is a different method, so I'd flag that and pass it on.

250 m × 42 m FPSO, 16 m draft, 120,000 t. 8-line spread in 150 m, anchor radius 600 m. Lines are R3 102 mm chain, 1,200 m long, 200 kN pretension. Screen against Hs 3 m / Tp 8 s, 0.3 m/s current, 8 m/s wind — all collinear. Make-up's in the file.

Got it — steel chain, so I'll run the intact screen directly. Basis I'll use: collinear wave-drift, current and wind built into a mean environmental load, quasi-static line tensions, and the intact safety factor of 1.67 from DNV / RP 2SK (OCIMF coefficients for the wind and current loads). The verdict checks each line's breaking load against tension × 1.67. Running it now…

Here's the intact screen. The spread is symmetric, so all 8 lines see the same governing tension:
LineMax tensionBreaking loadUtilisationSafety factorVerdict
ML1 (governing)5,859 kN12,200 kN48%2.08✅ Pass
ML2–ML85,859 kN12,200 kN48%2.08✅ Pass
All 8 lines pass — SF 2.08 against the 1.67 intact requirement, so good headroom. Total mean environmental load was 2,281 kN.

report.title: FPSO Spread-Mooring Screen
report.inputs:
Vessel
FPSO · 250 m × 42 m · draft 16 m · displacement 120,000 t · windage 5,000 m²

Mooring
8-line spread · water depth 150 m · anchor radius 600 m · fairlead radius 35 m
Lines: R3 102 mm chain · length 1,200 m · pretension 200 kN · breaking load 12,200 kN

Metocean (collinear, head-on)
wave Hs 3.0 m · Tp 8.0 s · current 0.3 m/s · wind 8.0 m/s

Load case
Intact screening · dynamic factor 1.0
report.methodology:
1 · Mean environmental load = wave-drift + current + wind, collinear (OCIMF coefficients for current and wind).
2 · Quasi-static line tensions from the catenary spread at the mean offset.
3 · Required breaking load = max tension × intact safety factor 1.67 (DNV / RP 2SK).
4 · Utilisation = max tension ÷ breaking load; safety factor = breaking load ÷ max tension.
5 · Verdict: every line's breaking load must clear its required value.
report.outputs:

ML15,859 kN9,785 kN12,200 kN48%2.08✅ Pass

Environmental loads: wave-drift 1,900 kN · current 185 kN · wind 196 kN · total 2,281 kN.
Verdict: PASS — all 8 lines clear the intact requirement; min SF 2.08 vs 1.67 required, max utilisation 48%.
